divide-an-array-into-subarrays-with-mini.hint: Sliding Window + Sorted Multiset: Binary search the cost or maintain a window with an ordered multiset to pick k minimal subarray starts under the distance constraint.

maximum-good-subarray-sum.title: Maximum Good Subarray Sum
maximum-good-subarray-sum.hint: Prefix + Hashmap: Track prefix sums and the minimum prefix seen for each value; for each index check value+k and value-k.

find-the-grid-of-region-average.title: Find the Grid of Region Average
find-the-grid-of-region-average.hint: 2D Region Average: For each pixel in interior, average all pixels within given distance. Use prefix sum 2D for O(1) region queries.

maximum-number-of-operations-with-the-sa.title: Maximum Number of Operations With the Same Score II
maximum-number-of-operations-with-the-sa.hint: Interval DP Merge: Try merging consecutive subarrays. dp[i][j]=min ops to sort A[i..j]. Merge valid when result <= next element.

apple-redistribution-into-boxes.title: Apple Redistribution into Boxes
apple-redistribution-into-boxes.hint: Bin Packing Greedy: Sort apples and apple boxes. For each group of required apples, pick smallest sufficient box count.

maximize-happiness-of-selected-children.title: Maximize Happiness of Selected Children
maximize-happiness-of-selected-children.hint: Greedy Sort: Sort happiness descending; pick the top k, subtracting i for the i-th pick and clamping at 0.

find-all-possible-stable-binary-arrays-i.title: Find All Possible Stable Binary Arrays I
find-all-possible-stable-binary-arrays-i.hint: DP with Run Limit: dp[zeros][ones][last bit] counts arrays respecting the max run length; transition by appending a 0 or 1.

find-all-possible-stable-binary-arrays-i.title: Find All Possible Stable Binary Arrays II
find-all-possible-stable-binary-arrays-i.hint: Optimized DP: Same run-limited DP as I, but accelerated with prefix sums over the previous state.

string-compression-iii.title: String Compression III
string-compression-iii.hint: String Processing: Scan characters while maintaining the needed state, counters, or parsed tokens.

find-the-maximum-length-of-valid-subsequ.title: Find the Maximum Length of Valid Subsequence I
find-the-maximum-length-of-valid-subsequ.hint: Parity DP: A valid subsequence keeps consecutive-pair sums of constant parity; greedily track the two parity cases and take the longest.

count-submatrices-with-equal-frequency-o.title: Count Submatrices With Equal Frequency of X and Y
count-submatrices-with-equal-frequency-o.hint: 2D Prefix Counts: Build prefix counts of X and Y; count submatrices whose X count equals Y count and is positive.

maximum-score-from-grid-operations.title: Maximum Score From Grid Operations
maximum-score-from-grid-operations.hint: Column DP: DP across columns carrying the shaded prefix length, with transitions scoring newly covered cells.

minimum-number-of-seconds-to-make-mounta.title: Minimum Number of Seconds to Make Mountain Height Zero
minimum-number-of-seconds-to-make-mounta.hint: Binary Search on Time: Binary search total seconds; a worker with rate r clears height h in r*(1+2+..+h) time, so check the combined reachable height.

construct-the-minimum-bitwise-array-i.title: Construct the Minimum Bitwise Array I
construct-the-minimum-bitwise-array-i.hint: Bit Construction: For each value, the minimum x with x | (x+1) == value is value with its lowest run-of-ones boundary flipped (-1 if value is even-incompatible).

construct-the-minimum-bitwise-array-ii.title: Construct the Minimum Bitwise Array II
construct-the-minimum-bitwise-array-ii.hint: Bit Construction: As in part I, set the answer by flipping the lowest 0-bit that follows a 1 in each value.

identify-the-largest-outlier-in-an-array.title: Identify the Largest Outlier in an Array
identify-the-largest-outlier-in-an-array.hint: Sum + Counts: Total sum minus an outlier equals twice the special-element sum; test each candidate using value counts.

transformed-array.title: Transformed Array
transformed-array.hint: Modular Index: result[i] = nums[((i + nums[i]) % n + n) % n].

maximum-subarray-sum-with-length-divisib.title: Maximum Subarray Sum With Length Divisible by K
maximum-subarray-sum-with-length-divisib.hint: Prefix Sum mod K: Track the minimum prefix sum for each index residue mod k; best = prefix[j] - min prefix at same residue before j.

design-task-manager.title: Design Task Manager
design-task-manager.hint: Heap + Maps: Keep a max-structure keyed by (priority, taskId) plus owner/priority maps; use lazy deletion for edits and removals.

maximum-amount-of-money-robot-can-earn.title: Maximum Amount of Money Robot Can Earn
maximum-amount-of-money-robot-can-earn.hint: Grid DP with States: DP over cells carrying how many negative cells have been neutralized (0,1,2), maximizing collected money.

count-partitions-with-even-sum-differenc.title: Count Partitions with Even Sum Difference
count-partitions-with-even-sum-differenc.hint: Prefix Parity: For each split point the difference parity depends only on the total sum's parity; count valid splits accordingly.

maximum-frequency-after-subarray-operati.title: Maximum Frequency After Subarray Operation
maximum-frequency-after-subarray-operati.hint: Per-Value Window: For each target letter, run a max-subarray (Kadane-style) on +1 for that letter / -1 for the chosen source letter to find the best gain.

separate-squares-i.title: Separate Squares I
separate-squares-i.hint: Binary Search Geometry: Binary search the horizontal line y so the square area above equals the area below.

separate-squares-ii.title: Separate Squares II
separate-squares-ii.hint: Sweep + Segment Tree: Sweep the line while maintaining union area with a segment tree, binary searching the balancing height.

maximum-sum-with-at-most-k-elements.title: Maximum Sum With at Most K Elements
maximum-sum-with-at-most-k-elements.hint: Per-Row Top + Heap: Take the top 'limit' values of each row, then select the global top k by value.

unique-3-digit-even-numbers.title: Unique 3-Digit Even Numbers
unique-3-digit-even-numbers.hint: Set of Numbers: Enumerate even 3-digit numbers formable from the digits (no leading zero) and count distinct ones.

closest-equal-element-queries.title: Closest Equal Element Queries
closest-equal-element-queries.hint: Value Index Map + Binary Search: Map each value to its sorted (circular) indices; for each query binary search the nearest equal-value index.

minimum-pair-removal-to-sort-array-i.title: Minimum Pair Removal to Sort Array I
minimum-pair-removal-to-sort-array-i.hint: Simulation: Repeatedly merge the adjacent pair with the smallest sum until the array is non-decreasing, counting operations.

minimum-pair-removal-to-sort-array-ii.title: Minimum Pair Removal to Sort Array II
minimum-pair-removal-to-sort-array-ii.hint: Heap + Linked List: Maintain adjacent-sum candidates in a heap over a doubly linked list with lazy deletion to merge efficiently.

minimum-absolute-difference-in-sliding-s.title: Minimum Absolute Difference in Sliding Submatrix
minimum-absolute-difference-in-sliding-s.hint: Sliding Submatrix: For each k x k window, compute the minimum absolute difference among contained values.

maximize-spanning-tree-stability-with-up.title: Maximize Spanning Tree Stability with Upgrades
maximize-spanning-tree-stability-with-up.hint: Binary Search + MST: Binary search the minimum stability; check feasibility with a Union-Find/MST that applies the allowed edge upgrades.

minimum-jumps-to-reach-end-via-prime-tel.title: Minimum Jumps to Reach End via Prime Teleportation
minimum-jumps-to-reach-end-via-prime-tel.hint: BFS over Prime Groups: Sieve smallest prime factors; link each index to others sharing a prime factor and BFS for minimum jumps.

minimum-removals-to-balance-array.title: Minimum Removals To Balance Array
minimum-removals-to-balance-array.hint: Math/Scan: Sort or scan array, apply pattern-specific formula based on problem structure.

trionic-array-i.title: Trionic Array I
trionic-array-i.hint: Three-Phase Scan: Check there exist i<j with strictly increasing [0..i], strictly decreasing [i..j], then strictly increasing [j..end].

minimum-cost-path-with-edge-reversals.title: Minimum Cost Path with Edge Reversals
minimum-cost-path-with-edge-reversals.hint: 0-1 BFS / Dijkstra: Add each original edge with weight w and a reverse edge with weight 2w, then run Dijkstra from the source.

minimum-cost-path-with-teleportations.title: Minimum Cost Path with Teleportations
minimum-cost-path-with-teleportations.hint: Layered Dijkstra: Run Dijkstra over grid moves plus value-based teleport edges, tracking remaining teleports as state.

best-time-to-buy-and-sell-stock-using-st.title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock using Strategy
best-time-to-buy-and-sell-stock-using-st.hint: Prefix + Window: Use prefix sums of price*strategy and slide the modifiable window to evaluate the best strategy change.

xor-after-range-multiplication-queries-i.title: XOR After Range Multiplication Queries II
xor-after-range-multiplication-queries-i.hint: Sqrt Decomposition: Apply large-stride range-multiply queries directly and batch small strides, recomputing the XOR.

jump-game-ix.title: Jump Game IX
jump-game-ix.hint: Greedy Segmentation: Use running prefix max/min reachability to segment the array and decide reachable jumps.

maximum-walls-destroyed-by-robots.title: Maximum Walls Destroyed by Robots
maximum-walls-destroyed-by-robots.hint: Interval DP/Greedy: Sort robots and choose a left/right firing direction for each to maximize destroyed walls (interval DP).

minimum-operations-to-equalize-binary-st.title: Minimum Operations to Equalize Binary String
minimum-operations-to-equalize-binary-st.hint: Greedy Parity: Reason on counts of mismatched bits and the flip block size k; greedily flip while respecting parity feasibility.

longest-balanced-substring-i.title: Longest Balanced Substring I
longest-balanced-substring-i.hint: Prefix Balance: Map +1/-1 prefix balance to its first index; the longest span with equal endpoints is the longest balanced substring.

longest-balanced-substring-ii.title: Longest Balanced Substring II
longest-balanced-substring-ii.hint: Prefix Balance: Same first-occurrence prefix-balance technique applied at the larger constraints.

longest-balanced-subarray-i.title: Longest Balanced Subarray I
longest-balanced-subarray-i.hint: Prefix Sum Hashmap: Map prefix balance to its earliest index; the longest balanced subarray is the widest equal-balance span.

lexicographically-smallest-permutation-g.title: Lexicographically Smallest Permutation Greater Than Target
lexicographically-smallest-permutation-g.hint: Next Permutation: Apply next-permutation logic under the given constraints to get the smallest permutation exceeding the target.

longest-balanced-subarray-ii.title: Longest Balanced Subarray II
longest-balanced-subarray-ii.hint: Prefix Balance + Monotonic: Track prefix balances with a monotonic structure to find the longest balanced subarray.

minimum-time-to-complete-all-deliveries.title: Minimum Time to Complete All Deliveries
minimum-time-to-complete-all-deliveries.hint: Greedy Math: Pair deliveries to capacity and compute the minimum completion time from the resulting schedule.

minimum-distance-between-three-equal-ele.title: Minimum Distance Between Three Equal Elements I
minimum-distance-between-three-equal-ele.hint: Grouped Indices: Group positions by value; the answer is the minimum span across any three consecutive same-value indices.

lexicographically-smallest-negated-permu.title: Lexicographically Smallest Negated Permutation that Sums to Target
lexicographically-smallest-negated-permu.hint: Greedy Sign Assignment: Greedily assign signs/negations from the most significant choice while keeping the sum reachable.

minimum-absolute-distance-between-mirror.title: Minimum Absolute Distance Between Mirror Pairs
minimum-absolute-distance-between-mirror.hint: Hash Positions: Hash element positions and, for each, find its nearest mirror counterpart to minimize the distance.

minimum-swaps-to-avoid-forbidden-values.title: Minimum Swaps to Avoid Forbidden Values
minimum-swaps-to-avoid-forbidden-values.hint: Greedy + Binary Search: Assign values avoiding forbidden positions, using binary search to count the minimum swaps.

minimum-subarray-length-with-distinct-su.title: Minimum Subarray Length With Distinct Sum At Least K
minimum-subarray-length-with-distinct-su.hint: Sliding Window: Expand/shrink a window tracking the sum of its distinct values until it reaches at least k, minimizing length.

find-maximum-value-in-a-constrained-sequ.title: Find Maximum Value in a Constrained Sequence
find-maximum-value-in-a-constrained-sequ.hint: Constraint DP: Propagate the maximum reachable value forward subject to the adjacency constraint.

maximum-bitwise-and-after-increment-oper.title: Maximum Bitwise AND After Increment Operations
maximum-bitwise-and-after-increment-oper.hint: Greedy Bits: Decide each bit from the most significant down, checking whether the budget of increments can keep it set across all elements.

final-element-after-subarray-deletions.title: Final Element After Subarray Deletions
final-element-after-subarray-deletions.hint: Monotonic Stack: Greedily simulate the allowed adjacent deletions with a stack to find the surviving final element.

minimum-cost-to-split-into-ones.title: Minimum Cost to Split into Ones
minimum-cost-to-split-into-ones.hint: Greedy/DP Decomposition: Split the target into ones using the cheapest power-based operations.

minimum-operations-to-sort-a-string.title: Minimum Operations to Sort a String
minimum-operations-to-sort-a-string.hint: Cycle Counting: Compute the minimum swaps to sort by counting per-character displacement cycles.

longest-arithmetic-sequence-after-changi.title: Longest Arithmetic Sequence After Changing At Most One Element
longest-arithmetic-sequence-after-changi.hint: Difference DP: dp[i][diff] for arithmetic runs, allowing one element to be changed, taking the best length.

minimum-operations-to-make-array-non-dec.title: Minimum Operations to Make Array Non Decreasing
minimum-operations-to-make-array-non-dec.hint: Greedy Stack: Merge decreasing runs from the left, counting the operations needed to make the array non-decreasing.

maximize-fixed-points-after-deletions.title: Maximize Fixed Points After Deletions
maximize-fixed-points-after-deletions.hint: Greedy/DP Matching: Maximize indices where value equals position after deletions via a matching DP.

minimum-cost-to-buy-apples-ii.title: Minimum Cost to Buy Apples II
minimum-cost-to-buy-apples-ii.hint: Dijkstra: Model the buying choices as a weighted graph and run Dijkstra for the minimum total cost.
